EXPERIENCE CRITERIA FOR CONSULTANTS. 1.1 The consultant shall be enlisted with MES in Category B in class I from E-in-C’s Branch, Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defen ce. 1.2 Un-enlisted bidders will have to get himself enlisted in appro priate Group and Category as per SOP for enlistment of consultants i ssued vide E-in-C’s letter No 3348/MISC/Consult/E2/E2 Ses-1 dated 1 6 Mar 2013 and amended as on date (available on website mes.gov.in) before submitting the bid. It is the responsibility of the b idders to forward enlistment letter to this office by bid submission en d date. No claim whatsoever will be entertained in this regard. 1.3 Not carrying adverse remarks in Work Load Report (WLR) or any other similar report circulated by any competent authority, if alread y working in MES. 1.4 Not suspended/debarred/blacklisted (either permanently or t emporarily) from participating in any bid or for business dealings b y any Central/State Government Department or any Central/State Government PSU or any Autonomous Body under Central/State Go vernment or any Local Body as on the bid submission end date. 2. PARTICULARS OF CONTRACTORS. Documents regarding Proprie torship/ Partnership/Private Limited concern to be submitted. Also, affidavi t regarding no sister concern in MES and no near relative in MES. 2.1 The Principal consultant should have a minimum experienc e of 30 years of expertise in the field of Civil Engineering & Concret e NDT. 2.2 The firm should have a Minimum 01 No ME/MT (structures) w ith 02 years experience & 01 No civil engineers B.E (Civil) with at lea st three years of experience.

2.3 The Firm should have at least 12 years of experience in the field of Structural Consultancy. 2.4 The firm should have carried out minimum 2 jobs of Structur al Audit, NDT of various Buildings for carrying out Condition Survey, Distress concrete in MES. Should have services of Licensed Structur al Engineers. 2.5 Firm shall be NABL Accredited for NDT Testing. 3. ENGINEERING ESTABLISHMENT. (The firm should have their ow n separate teams for conducting NDT test). 3.1 Certified copy of Certificate of registration of firm with regi ster of Firms. 3.2 Certified copies of enlistment letters with various Govt Dep artments/PSUs. 3.3 Copy of last five years Income Tax return filed. 3.4 Copy of details showing value of works completion in last fi ve years based on Form-26 AS. 3.5 Certified copy of PAN No / TIN No of proprietor / partners/ fi rm. NOTE. Contractor shall upload copies of all the above documents pri or to closing date of bid submission. 4. BIDDER FINANCIAL STANDING. The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankr upt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 5. Bidder are advised to check applicable GST on their own before qu oting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. 6 . NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uploaded with bid. 7. EMD amount to be given in Favor of CWE (NW) Mumbai. 8. Structural audit of building in Bid is dedicatedly carried out in Defen ce department restricted area and the firm should be registered with Engin eer-in-Chief’s Branch, Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defence.

9. In case the documents are found to be fraud the bidder shall be bla cklisted permanently. 10. Bidder should upload certificate signed by the Engineer-in-Charge t hat they have personally visited the site of building mentioned in name of work failing which their firm participation will be rejected. 11. Bidder’s offer is liable to be rejected if they don’t upload any of the Certificate/ documents sought in the Bid document, the Bidder shall be Te chnically disqualified.
